$description: SessionTimeout (platform/patterns/SessionTimeout), library wave 11, lane A: its pattern tokens. The text of the warning and the signed-out message, the time left in the data font, and, drawn in the page (inline), its title, gaps and width. In a dialog the frame, the title and the buttons are Dialog’s.

session-timeout-time-font-family.$description: SessionTimeout: the time left and the minutes: the data font (font-data).

session-timeout-inline-max-width.$description: SessionTimeout: the message in the page: its greatest width (size-400px, a small dialog’s).

session-timeout-inline-gap.$description: SessionTimeout: in the page: gap between the title, the text and the actions (space-stack-md).

session-timeout-title-text.$description: SessionTimeout: in the page: the title’s color (content-default).

session-timeout-title-font-family.$description: SessionTimeout: in the page: the title’s font (font-heading).

session-timeout-title-font-size.$description: SessionTimeout: in the page: the title’s size (font-size-15, a dialog title’s).

session-timeout-title-font-weight.$description: SessionTimeout: in the page: the title’s weight (font-weight-bold).

session-timeout-title-line-height.$description: SessionTimeout: in the page: the title’s line height (size-20px).

session-timeout-body-gap.$description: SessionTimeout: in the page: gap between the paragraphs (space-stack-sm).

session-timeout-actions-gap.$description: SessionTimeout: in the page: gap between the buttons (space-inline-sm).
